profile_text.body:
Super Micro Computer, Inc. is a public company headquartered in San Jose, California, traded under the ticker SMCI and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001375365. On its own site the company describes itself as a premier provider of advanced Server Building Block Solutions for the 5G/Edge, Data Center, Cloud, Enterprise, Big Data, HPC and Embedded markets worldwide.

Its site markets GPU servers for modern data centers and describes a comprehensive line of AI systems built around multi-GPU and interconnect technologies. It also lists short-depth and small form factor systems intended to bring compute, AI and connectivity performance to the edge of the network.

The company's legal exposure record shows 281 matters in California. No specific lawsuits are listed, and no AI products or MCP servers are recorded for it.
